tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, not pure white — reads like primed drywall, easier on the eyes in a bright truck cab.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, input fields, the estimate sheet. One step off surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed states, table header rows, selected rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, numbers, the wordmark. On surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units (sq ft, hrs). 4.5:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: The one brand color — painter's-tape blue. Primary buttons, links, the mark tile, focus rings. Never for large backgrounds behind body text.

tokens.name: on-tape
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a tape-filled surface.

tokens.name: tape-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted highlight behind a selected item or an info note. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: profit
tokens.usage: Healthy margin, success, job won. Pair with a + sign or label — never color alone.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Missing input, thin margin, estimate needs review.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Underbid, below cost, errors. Always with a word or − sign, not color alone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its input; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone screen side gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Major section breaks; page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the mark tile (14 on a 64 tile).
